topic: Meal-kit subscriptions after a price rise
decision: whether to reverse the April price rise on the Family plan

columns.price_per_week_usd: weekly price of the plan, US dollars
columns.active_subscribers: active subscribers at the start of the month
columns.new_signups: new subscriptions started during the month
columns.cancellation_rate_pct: cancellations as a percentage of active_subscribers
columns.avg_rating: average customer rating of delivered boxes, 1 to 5
columns.support_tickets: customer support tickets opened during the month

findings.text: Couple is the largest plan, with 21,832 active subscribers at the start of September 2026.
Vegetarian is the fastest-growing plan: active subscribers rose 39% between October 2025 and September 2026.
Family plan cancellations rose after its price went from $79 to $89 a week on 1 April 2026. The Family cancellation rate averaged 3.1% a month from October to March and 6.5% from April to August.
Support tickets peaked in December 2025 (1,621 across all plans) during holiday delivery delays.
New sign-ups peak in January: 2,804 across all plans in January 2026, the New Year rush.
Family plan active subscribers fell from 14,358 at the start of April to 11,625 at the start of September (-19%). The other three plans all grew over the year.
Vegetarian boxes have the highest average rating (4.59 out of 5).
Single has the lowest cancellation rate, averaging 2.4% a month.
September 2026 figures cover 1 to 14 September only, so September sign-ups and cancellations are about half a month. The Family plan's September cancellation rate of 3.1% is not a recovery.
Figures exclude gift subscriptions, which are about 3% of orders.

main.gist: Family-plan cancellations rose (and subscribers fell) after the April price rise

facts.q: What was the Family plan's monthly cancellation rate before the April 2026 price change, and after it? Give both in percent.
How many active Family plan subscribers were there at the start of April 2026, and at the start of September 2026?
